[[File:Pokémon Pocket Monsters XY volume 1.png|thumb|Cover artwork for Pocket Monsters XY volume 1]]
(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターXY''' ''Pocket Monsters XY'') is a {{wp|shōnen}} [[Pokémon manga]] created by 穴久保幸作 [[Kosaku Anakubo]]. It is follow-up to the {{OBP|Pocket Monsters BW|Kosaku Anakubo}} series, following the legacy of sequels to the original [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] series. The plot follows the adventures of {{PPM|Red}} and his Pokémon as they travel to the [[Kalos]] region. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick. It was succeeded by [[Pocket Monsters Sun Moon (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters Sun Moon]].
